kitchen.note: The kitchen mini PC: mic, speakers and NFC in one box. No rooms key, so its replies stay on its own speaker. music_player is the squeezelite jukebox the NFC reader also drives. Deliberately no music_volume: the kitchen's levels are their own domain (jukebox knob, announcements, New Mode) and voice music must not override them.

familyroom.note: Second microphone for the same open kitchen/family-room voice domain. Playback and alarms relay to the kitchen satellite, and its captions, responses and timers belong on the kitchen display. music_player is the SAME jukebox as the kitchen's, so the kitchen queue counts as local here: this mic hears those speakers, and a wake or alarm from it must duck them (2026-08-31: it wasn't, and 'close the left blind' over music came through as 'corner'). Deliberately no music_volume, for the kitchen's reasons.

master.note: Master closet. Since 2026-08-31 the microphone is the rooted Echo Dot 2 (EchoMuse), whose bridge on the Beelink is the host: mic, wake ding, light ring and the alarm dismiss listener live there. Spoken replies and timer alarms still go out the master bath speakers via the amp zone. Volume 20 - the amp runs hot gain on this zone; 50 was way too loud and 30 still a touch loud (measured 2026-08-07). alarm_volume is well above the reply volume on purpose - a reply is for someone standing there, an alarm has to carry over a running shower. Music starts at 20 and cannot be talked above 40 (the alarm is 45). music_cap_minutes stops it by itself: the people it plays for are in the tub, two rooms from the nearest microphone. The Pi 4 that used to be this satellite was retired 2026-08-31 (Dot verified 100% from the bath where the Pi's USB mic failed half the time).

simon.note: Voice PE in Simon's room. The device owns only mic, LED and chimes; replies, timer alarms and music use the Simon amp-zone speakers. Child-safe ceilings and a one-hour music cap are intentional.

claire.note: Voice PE in Claire's room, a twin of Simon's: the device owns only mic, LED and chimes; replies, timer alarms and music use the Claire amp-zone speakers. Same child-safe ceilings and one-hour music cap.
